subject: Fastest air freight quote to GRU
body:
Hi there,

Hope all’s well with you. Could you send me an all-in price in EUR for the fastest air freight option to GRU (Sao Paulo, BR)?

The shipment will be ready for pickup on 2026-11-27 at our site in 22911 (Hamburg North), Germany. Please include arranging the truck from our site to the airport.

It’s 6 pieces of electronic control units, with a gross weight of 671 kg and a total volume of 6.19 cbm. Could you also let me know the earliest arrival you can offer at GRU?

Thanks for taking a look!

We also need cargo insurance inside your all-in price: the goods are worth 81000 EUR, cover is 110 % of the value and the premium rate is 0.30 % (our frame agreement).

Cheers,
Klaus Weidner
Weidner Spielwaren GmbH, Nuremberg

classification.reasoning: The customer is requesting an all-in price and fastest air freight option for a new shipment to GRU.
